## lib-ssh-correlate (N8N-4.2)
**Trigger:** called by pb-ssh-bruteforce through Execute Workflow (waited for), after the enrichment, for created and repaired alerts.
**Inputs:** `{canonical, thehive_alert_id, severity, tags, source, route, observables, config}` (the canonical alert, this alert's TheHive id, severity and tags as sent, its observables as tagged by the extraction, lib-config).
**Actions taken:** reads only. Skips (`skipped` with the reason) when the alert has no `data.srcip`, or the address is not one of its ip observables, or it is tagged `agent` or `range:internal` (lib-config `ssh_correlation.skip_tags`). Otherwise one bounded TheHive query (`POST /api/v1/query?name=ssh-correlate`, credential TheHive API (n8n), lib-config `thehive_http` timeout and retries, N8N-6.2): alerts with an `ip` observable equal to `data.srcip`, TheHive `date` (= the Wazuh timestamp) within `window_s` (3600) of this alert's event time in both directions, carrying one of `prefilter_tags`, not this alert, at most `query_limit` (50). TheHive 5.7 has no caseTemplate query attribute, so the case templates (`ssh-bruteforce`, `suspicious-login`) and the window are checked again on the answer. Returns `status` done / skipped / failed (`class`: thehive_unreachable, thehive_4xx, bad_answer; never parks), the related alerts (`related`, `listed`: the `max_listed` nearest in time), and the plan: this alert's tags (`ssh-campaign:<srcip>`; on a brute-force alert that has a related 40112, also `ssh:login-after-bruteforce` and severity raised to `escalate_severity`), and on a 40112 the related `ssh-bruteforce` alerts to escalate (tag, severity raised if lower, never lowered: D12).
**Systems changed:** none (reads only).
**Approval:** not needed: reads only.
**Owner:** n8n.
Saved: failed executions only (lib- convention); no error workflow.
